text.p: Grain and oilseed exports reported by USDA and private export sources.

BARLEY SALE - Saudi Arabia bought about 1.4 million tonnes of barley at prices ranging from $146 to $158 per tonne, C and F, European grain traders said Monday. The barley is for delivery from October to December.

CORN TENDER - Results are due Tuesday on Taiwan's FGEP corn-buying group's tender for 54,000 tonnes of U.S. No.2 corn, traders said. Shipment is for Dec 10-25 if from the U.S. Gulf or Dec 26-Jan 9 if from the Pacific Northwest.
CORN TENDERS - Jordan is to seek 50,000 tonnes of U.S. Number 3 yellow corn for shipment in first half of November. Offers must be received by September 25.

- The South African Maize Board was offering up to 33,000 tonnes of white corn for export in one unit of 20,000, 25,000 or 33,000 tonnes for shipment on October 23 to November 1, from Durban. The tender closes on September 25.
- CCC said it is seeking up to 16,000 tonnes U.S. No.2 or better yellow corn for donation to Rwanda. Shipment period is set for December 5-30 and offers are due by September 24.
SOYBEAN TENDER - Taiwan Sugar Corp is expected to tender this week for 18,000 tonnes of No.2 U.S. corn and 12,000 tonnes of No.2 U.S. soybeans for Oct 25-Nov 10 shipment.

RICE TENDERS - Moldova will tender Wednesday for 14,000 tonnes of PL-480 long-grain milled rice in bags, the country's agent said. Moldova seeks No. 2 grade or better rice for shipment between Nov 1 and 25.
- Jordan seeks 15,OOO tonnes of medium grain camolina rice Tuesday. Offers must be received by Sept 24 in two 7,500 tonne lots for November shipment.

WHEAT TENDERS - Pakistan will tender for 200,000 tonnes U.S. grade 2 or better soft white wheat under the GSM-102 program for October 10-31 shipment, its U.S. export agent said. Bids are due September 29 and must remain valid until Sepember 30.

- Angola seeks 17,850 tonnes of U.S. No.2 or better PL-480 hard red winter wheat in bulk under the PL 480 Title I export donation program, its U.S. export agent said. The delivery period is set for October 10-25. Bids must be received by September 24 and remain valid until Sept 25.

WHEAT TENDERS (cont.) - The CCC seeks up to 35,000 tonnes of U.S. No.2 or better soft red winter or soft white wheat for donation to Eritrea. Shipment is set for Oct 10-Nov 5. Offers are due by Sept 26.
- The CCC seeks up to 42,000 tonnes of U.S. No. 2 or better hard red winter wheat for donation to Georgia for Oct 10-Nov 5 shipment. Offers are due by September 23.

- Syria's General Establishment for Cereal Processing and Trade offered 100,000 tonnes of hard amber durum wheat for sale for November shipment. October 1 is the final date for offers. Confirmation is set on October 2.

VEGETABLE OIL TENDER - The Egyptian state's Food Industries Company said Monday it seeks to buy 34,000 to 55,000 tonnes of edible oils for first-half November delivery or first-half December. Bids will be opened at 1200 local time (1000 GMT) on October 9 and must be valid for 48 hours.

MARKET TALK - USDA grain export inspections for the week ended September 19 include: soybeans 8.89 million bushels vs 9.452 million the previous week; wheat 25.403 million vs 28.988 million; corn 23.081 million vs 20.959 million; sorghum 950,000 vs 2.700 million; and barley 2.822 million vs 202,000... Holidays in Japan and South Korea, along with high corn premiums, may sideline grain and oilseed buyers this week despite a fall in trans-Pacific freight rates and lower prices in Chicago, grain traders said on Monday...Turkish officials said Monday they expected wheat imports by private companies to fall after a weekend decree curbing wheat and corn imports by raising taxes. The official reiterated earlier official estimates that Turkey would have a bumper wheat harvest of about 19 million tonnes in 1996/97, up from 15.5 million tonnes last year...China's corn imports fell to 440,000 tonnes in the first eight months of 1996, down 81.6 percent compared with year-ago period, customs figures showed on Monday.
